body: SCOPE AMENDMENT to C3: the draft is internally inconsistent about the first replay court. Required law 11 and first-slice item 7 promise a byte-identical NarrativeCompilation artifact, while Consequences correctly says codecs must preserve the artifact before exact replay can be claimed. A Scala value in document has equality/fingerprint, not canonical bytes, and document cannot own the circe wire format. Current reservations cover only document compiler/test plus the ADR. Choose one honest slice: either (a) first slice proves structural equality plus content-fingerprint invariance and explicitly defers byte identity, or (b) add the codec surface, versioned canonical encoding, decode round-trip, and timestamp rule to this candidate. Do not serialize ad hoc inside document to make a byte test green.
